It prevents a deprivileged host using higher-privilege SMM to read protected guest memory; the port does not create that private memory boundary. Native firmware code is unchanged. Commit-message source URLs and destructive hardware test recipes were not accessed/executed. Supplied Goldfish boot contract leaves the opt-in protected-host backend disabled; generic Android virtualization is not presumed absent. See the positive runtime/build gate and exact native-file proofs in pkvm-host-tail-review.json.

boot_contract.install_rule: board/kernel/x86_64.mk installs kernel_cmdline.txt; BOARD_KERNEL_CMDLINE explicitly unsupported

method: Enumerated every changed path and hunk. Read every shared-path hunk in full; checked entire shared files against LTS. Private implementation paths, symbols and hunk scopes were classified against the positively established separate image/build/runtime gate, with selected initialization/security-fix patches read in full. Not a claim of line-by-line semantic correctness review of every omitted private implementation. All private files are absent from both native and port. No source change or runtime execution in this review.
limits: Ordinary SDK supplied boot contract only. Other command-line overrides, pvmfw bootloader provisioning and protected-VM guests/host behavior are not supported or verified by this decision. Native KVM compilation is not virtualization runtime verification. Shared VFIO/IOMMU and x86 protected-guest candidates outside this list remain separately reviewed/provisional.
